The '''Grig Employee Training School''' was located on [[Central Avenue]] in [[Grig]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. It was used to educate the native [[Nargan]]s with [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-training tapes. It was connected to the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center]] via a walkway.<ref name="The Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
